description: Act on the accessible element a selector finds, without coordinates: set_value (replace a field's text, or a slider's value, with value), clear, toggle (a check box), expand or collapse (a menu, combo box or tree item), invoke (press a button, follow a link), select (a list item, tab or radio button; with value, the option of that name inside a combo box or list), focus, scroll_into_view. Prefer it to clicking and typing at guessed coordinates: it acts on exactly the element you name. Roles match across systems ('button', 'push button' and 'Button' are the same); a multi-line editor is 'document' on Windows (Notepad) and 'text' on Linux. Returns the element afterwards (its value and states such as checked, expanded, selected).

exact.description: Require an exact match instead of a substring

index.description: Which match when several do (0, the first, in capsulate_find_element's order)

role.description: Accessible role, e.g. 'button', 'menu item', 'text', 'terminal' (Linux AT-SPI) or 'Button', 'Edit' (Windows UI Automation)

text.description: Match against the name OR the value

value.description: For set_value, the new text; for select, the name of the option to choose inside the element

window.description: Only within the window whose title contains this

name: capsulate_element
title: Act on a UI element
